sentences.englishText: Derek Matthews was not a successful student at school because he loved horses instead.
sentences.turkishText: Derek Matthews okulda başarılı bir öğrenci değildi çünkü bunun yerine atları seviyordu.

sentences.englishText: He wanted to be a jockey and now he owns a famous riding school in Ascot.
sentences.turkishText: Jokey olmak istiyordu ve şu anda Ascot'ta ünlü bir binicilik okulunun sahibidir.

sentences.englishText: Derek drives to his riding school three times a week to ride and enjoy his time.
sentences.turkishText: Derek, at binmek ve vaktinin tadını çıkarmak için haftada üç kez binicilik okuluna sürer.

enrichment.summary: Derek Matthews was not a successful student at school because he loved horses instead. He wanted to be a jockey and now he owns a famous riding school in Ascot.
